text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, is it someone's birthday today?
Everyone
keeps yappin' about how they
got a cake.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What are you saying? Today is not just someone's birthday, it's your birthday.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, you've no need to beat
around the
bush. We've already made all
the preparations
necessary to celebrate.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That said, it comes as no surprise that
you didn't
notice. This past week,
everything has been
proceeding in
utmost secrecy...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Man, you played me like a damn fiddle.
Who
woulda thunk you of all people
would be folding
origami flowers...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: How do you know about that?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't get your socks untied.
Instead, lemme
tell you the first word
that ever came outta my
mouth!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That won't be necessary. I am not
curious in the
slightest, and I also still
need to ask the Mejiro
chefs to bake
some of their finest pizzas for
today.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It was long ago, back when I started
getting
bored of counting the legs on a
Hallucigenia... I
boarded a vessel sailing
west, and thus
proclaimed...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"You can never go wrong with cake or
pizza, but
you know what would hit the
spot right now?
Sukiyaki."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fine, then I shall instruct them to
prepare that as
well!
